mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id, c.scope, c.status, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT m.content FROM ai_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND m.role = 'USER' ORDER BY m.message_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS first_user_message, (SELECT MAX(m2.created_at) FROM ai_messages m2 WHERE m2.conversation_id = c.conversation_id) AS last_message_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_proposals p WHERE p.conversation_id = c.conversation_id AND p.status = 'PROPOSED') AS pending_proposal_count FROM ai_conversations c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} HAVING last_message_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_message_at DESC
